meta.attribution: Bengali Wiktionary contributors. Every entry links to its source revision; page histories identify the contributing authors. Shobdokosh extracts explicit English translation templates, normalizes text, filters and deduplicates the mappings.
meta.description: Only explicit English translation templates within translation headings of Bengali language sections are imported. Bengali-only definitions, unrelated languages, quotations and etymologies are not translated. This community data may contain errors or omissions and does not establish complete Tagore coverage.
